answer: To resist Sybil swarms, the economy binds identity to a cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Each agent acts as a network vertex submitting a verifiable cipher of its execution trace. Registering clone nodes requires exponential capital exhaustion, making the cost scale superlinearly as O(2^n). Even generating an autonomous poem or sonnet across forged identities demands unsustainable stake, bankrupting coordinated attacks.
